notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.content:
Important Game Update with New Features:

New Swimsuit Outfit
New Jumping Actions

Several Bug Fixes

notes.title: Airi's World Update
notes.content:
Airi's World Game has been updated with the latest Steamworks SDK, the graphics has been improved and the game has been reviewed to fix bugs.

We recommend to keep your games updated.

Thanks.

notes.title: New Update Available
notes.content:
New Update Has Been Release:

v.2.0.0
All levels has been remade, two are full new levels.

More Details of this update:

All Game has been remake:
New Houses Enviroments.
Expanded Town Enviroment.
Complete New Levels for Castle enviroment.
Complete New Level for Beach enviroment.
New Black Pink Outfit.
Horse Updated.

Thanks, Have fun.
